glosses: Gear consisting of a set of articles or tools for a specified purpose.
Any cohesive group of people; a unit; such as a military company.

examples.text: The League of One was suddenly exposed and in danger of being hunted by enemies of the salarians. Before any harm could be done, the team mysteriously disappeared.[...]Realizing the threat posed by this rogue outfit, the Special Tasks Group dispatched a team of hunters. glosses: A business or firm.

examples.text: Should we buy it here, or do you think the outfit across town will have a better deal?

glosses: A sports team.

examples.text: With only two fit centre-backs available, Tottenham boss Harry Redknapp employed young midfielder Jake Livermore at the back alongside Sebastien Bassong but Spurs struggled against a seasoned Champions League outfit, who beat Barcelona at the Nou Camp in 2009-10 and continually worked their way between the home defence to create some golden opportunities.

examples.text: […] the outfit of 1821, which outfit suffered a loss. From 1822 there were profits on each outfit as the many subsequent credit entries indicate.

glosses: To provide with, usually for a specific purpose.
